results.summary_before: This project is an 8-bit UART transmitter that converts parallel ASCII data (characters 0x40 to 0x5F) into a standard UART frame using a parallel-in-serial-out shift register architecture. It uses D flip-flops and multiplexers to load data and then shift it out serially with start, stop, and idle bits. The design is intended for educational purposes and requires external DIP switches for input, a 7-segment display for debugging, status LEDs, and a logic analyzer or UART-to-USB converter to verify the serial output.
